payload.title: Model-Data Confrontation in the Spectral Domain
payload.summary: This Jupyter notebook demonstrates the use of spectral analysis features in Pyleoclim to compare climate variability across scales between climate models and proxy records, reproducing results from Zhu et al. (2019). It involves data exploration, processing PMIP3 last millennium simulations, and analyzing proxies, LMR, and deglacial simulations. The notebook performs spectral analysis using the WWZ method and visualizes power spectral densities (PSDs). It also estimates scaling exponents for various datasets.
goals: Perform spectral analysis on climate data.
Compare climate variability across scales between models and proxy records.
Reproduce results from Zhu et al. (2019).

section_blurbs.heading: PMIP3 last millennium simulations

section_blurbs.heading: Proxies, LMR, and deglacial simulations
